description: Barge-in: cooling tower at a plastics plant with no water circulating. The technician asks for the 1/2" valve but says it fast and buried mid-sentence; search_part resolves the 3/4" one (the most common) and the agent starts the read-back with the wrong part: the technician INTERRUPTS them mid-phrase ('no, no — it was the 1/2 one, not the 3/4!'). Three provoked interruptions in total (turns 7, 15 and 17); the agent must yield in <500 ms, never talk over them nor lose the turn.

turns.text: Can you hear me?... ok, I'm at building seven, right by the cooling tower... I've got the order for the no-circulation call... ok, let's go.
turns.note: low plant noise in the background (fans); technician with busy hands

turns.hint: get_order(OT-1005); summarize (tower 3V-425 not circulating, drip on the feed line) and ask for the current state.

turns.text: So the tower isn't wetting the fill... the pump is running dry and I shut the main valve because it drips from a hose that's rotten already... and the line's shutoff valve won't open right, ok, that valve... the half inch one, the small one.
turns.note: talks fast; 'the half inch one' arrives buried at the end of the sentence (triggers the wrong VLV-034-BR candidate at turn 6)

turns.hint: set_problem with the technician's text; ask for the diagnosis: what they checked before closing.

turns.text: I pushed pressure through with the service hose and the water won't pass... the valve's gasket is just gone, it pops when pressure goes in... the tower hose burst at the fitting too... the whole valve has to go, there's no repairing it.
turns.note: wrench clank in the background; heavy tooling sounds

turns.hint: search_part('shutoff valve') resolves the top candidate VLV-034-BR (3/4", the most common in the catalog); add it and START the read-back: 'Did you mean the brass ball valve THREE QUAR—'. MUST let itself be interrupted as soon as the user speaks.

turns.text: No, no — it was the 1/2 one, not the 3/4!... the half inch one, look, I've got the old one right here in my hand... one piece, half inch, that's it.
turns.note: INTERRUPTION 1: cuts the agent mid-word (expected agent_text_cut: 'Did you mean the brass ball valve THREE QUAR—'); the agent must go silent <500 ms and NOT finish the phrase

turns.hint: Yield immediately; fix the card (drop VLV-034-BR, add VLV-012-BR qty 1); re-confirm out loud, short: 'Brass ball valve HALF INCH, ONE piece, shall I confirm?'.
Log the confirmation (and the barge_in in the artifact); ask about the burst hose: gauge and length.

turns.text: The hose is the five eighths neoprene one, reinforced... a one meter run... one piece, and while you're at it jot down that the pump motor was already sounding fine by the end.
turns.note: asks for the part and drops an extra note without the agent asking

turns.hint: search_part('neoprene hose 5/8'); add_part_to_report MAN-058-NE qty 1; read-back: 'Reinforced neoprene hose FIVE EIGHTHS, ONE piece, correct?' — and log the pump remark into notes (free text, no confirm_request).
Log the confirmation; starts asking how much time— (phrase left unfinished).

turns.text: —an hour, like I've been telling you... ok, ok... sixty minutes, put down an hour and that's it.
turns.note: INTERRUPTION 2: answers the question before the agent finishes asking it; natural impatience

turns.hint: Yield, get_work_time (~60 min), proposed set_solution; starts the final summary out loud: 'Here's your card: swapped the half inch valve, the five eighths hose, one hour of work, and the motor note—'.

turns.text: Ok, ok, it's perfect, don't repeat the whole thing!... send it already, I've got another stop to get to.
turns.note: INTERRUPTION 3: cuts the final summary; orders immediate send

turns.hint: Cut the summary WITHOUT finishing it, confirm in three words ('card sent, good vibes') and close. All 3 interruptions are logged as barge_in in the artifact.
